title: LifecycleConfiguration
description: Optional presentation metadata for guided lifecycle workflows. Executable nodes and edges remain authoritative; editors must verify that the metadata compiles to the saved graph before editing it as stages.

transitions.description: Moves besides the onboarding path, from the stages each one lists or from any stage, to any stage: made once the asset meets their conditions, or when a user requests them.

lifecycleTransition.description: A move the lifecycle makes between two of its stages: a step of its onboarding path made on request, or a move besides that path such as In Review to Rejected, Rejected back to Draft, or any stage to Deprecated.

from.description: Stages the move is made from. Empty or absent means any stage other than the one it moves to.

to.description: The stage the asset moves to.

trigger.description: automatic moves the asset once the conditions are met, after its approvers approve when it names any; onRequest waits until a user requests the move, which its conditions must allow and its approvers approve.

conditions.description: JSON Logic condition the asset must meet: an automatic transition waits for it, and a request for an on-request one is refused until it holds. Required for an automatic transition.

approval.description: Who approves the move. An on-request transition always names approvers, and its request is a status update task assigned to them; an automatic one may name approvers, who are asked once the conditions are met.

assignees.description: Groups of the asset asked to approve.

candidates.description: Specific users and teams asked in addition to the groups.

onPath.description: This transition is a step of the onboarding path that the lifecycle makes on request instead of automatically. The path's own stage holds the asset until the request is approved.

checks.description: Fields the asset must fill in before it can leave the stage.

conditions.description: JSON Logic condition the asset must also meet before it can leave the stage.

task.description: Who is asked to fill in the missing fields or get the conditions met. Without it the stage holds the asset and asks no one (ADR:2026-10-15-a-lifecycle-stage-asks-for-its-missing-metadata-in-one-task).

lifecycleGate.description: A stage of the guided lifecycle: the fields and conditions an asset needs before it can leave the stage, and who is asked to complete them.

lifecycleFieldCheck.description: A field the asset must fill in before it can leave the gate's stage.

valueType.description: Number and boolean fields accept zero and false as filled-in values.
